279592897.description: This listing includes three vintage glass insulators marked 'WHITALL TATUM No 1'. Manufactured by the Whitall Tatum company, these insulators were used for telegraph and power lines during the early to mid-20th century. The glass ranges from clear to slightly smoky in color. Each insulator measures approximately 3-4 inches in height. The items are in good vintage condition with surface wear and dirt consistent with age and outdoor use. No major cracks or chips are visible. Each piece features embossed manufacturer details on the base.

280293556.description:
Natural Geode Specimens
Set of Two Quartz Crystal Formations
Natural Mineral Specimen
Total Weight: 5.14 lbs
Unsigned
This pair of natural geode specimens features prominent internal crystalline structures characteristic of quartz formations. The larger, more rounded piece showcases a deep cavity lined with translucent to opaque white crystals, while the second piece displays a more open, heart-shaped configuration. Both specimens retain their natural, rough exterior matrix, providing a striking contrast between the rugged outer shell and the delicate crystalline interior.
Rounder geode measures approximately 6.25" x 4.25" x 4"
Authentic mineral specimens with natural crystalline sparkle and textural variety
Ideal for geological study, home decor display, or as a natural history collectible
Total combined weight of 5.14 lbs as measured on a digital scale
Condition:
Good natural condition. Both pieces exhibit natural residue and geological imperfections consistent with authentic mineral specimens. Surfaces are stable but possess the inherent irregularities of raw earth materials.
